zh: 要让 k 个元素之和最大，只要选中的某个元素比某个未选中的元素小，交换它们就能让和变大。
所以最优方案就是取最大的 k 个元素；值相同的元素按不同下标分别计算，互换不影响答案。
把数组从大到小排序，累加前 k 项并输出；总和可达 10¹⁴，必须用 64 位整数。
en: To maximise the sum of k elements: whenever a chosen element is smaller than an unchosen one, swapping them increases the sum.
So the optimal choice is the k largest elements; equal values at different indices count separately, and swapping equal values does not change the answer.
Sort the array in descending order, add up the first k values and print the sum; it can reach 10^14, so 64-bit integers are required.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort in descending order and sum the first k values using 64-bit integers.

## Correctness

If a chosen element is smaller than an unchosen element, swapping them increases the total. Therefore an optimal plan can and must take the k largest values (swapping equal values does not affect the answer).

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
